categories.name: Bridge & Transportation Moulds
categories.description: Project-specific steel mould systems for precast bridge, viaduct and rail components, developed around the approved section, casting method and production layout.

categories.name: Building Component Moulds
categories.description: Steel mould systems for repeat production of structural and architectural building components, configured around component geometry, embedded items and factory workflow.

categories.name: Tunnel & Underground Moulds
categories.description: Purpose-designed mould systems for tunnel and underground components, reviewed against joint details, internal-form withdrawal, handling and production conditions.

categories.name: Municipal & Infrastructure Moulds
categories.description: Project-specific mould systems for drainage, utility, road and civil-infrastructure components, with operation selected to match geometry, output and handling requirements.

categories.name: Marine & Coastal Moulds
categories.description: Steel mould systems for breakwater and coastal-protection units, developed from the approved unit geometry, casting direction, demoulding method and production target.

categories.name: Retaining Wall & Block Moulds
categories.description: Mould systems for retaining-wall panels and large concrete blocks, reviewed around face finish, connection details, demoulding direction and lifting interfaces.

categories.name: Volumetric & Special Precast Moulds
categories.description: Custom engineering for three-dimensional and special precast components where openings, embedded items, inner-form withdrawal and transport limits require project review.
